===============================================================================
MT6991 System Control and Management Interface(SCMI) Vendor Protocols Extension
===============================================================================

:Copyright: |copy| 2025 Collabora Ltd.

:Author: AngeloGioacchino Del Regno <angelogioacchino.delregno@collabora.com>

MediaTek TinySYS is a hardware subsystem providing a Tiny System MCU which is
capable of controlling various aspects of the SoC, including interactions with
other hardware subsystems and other integrated MCUs.

The main TinySYS function typically routes SCMI messages to various MCUs in
other hardware subsystems, or internally converts requests to Inter Processor
Interrupts (IPI) requests and forwards those to the target remote processor.

The TinySYS hardware subsystem implements an interface compliant with the Arm
SCMI Specification with additional vendor specific extensions.

System Control and Management Interface - MediaTek TinySYS Vendor Protocol
========================================================================

MediaTek TinySYS is a low-level system function which runs on a SoC-integrated
MCU to support various power management and performance settings including, but
not limited to:

- GPU power limit indications
- DRAM Power Manager (DPM) low power setting
- System Level Buffer and Cache (SLBC) resources management
  - SRAM and Cache partitioning, assignment, activation and power control
- Secure System Power Manager (SSPM) power control
- MCU Power Manager (MCUPM)'s Power Select (PWRSEL) functions
- Various performance logging functions in remote processors

This protocol provides three main commands:

- Common (generic) set/get
- Power State Notification
- SLBC Control

Commands:
_________

PROTOCOL_VERSION
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

message_id: 0x0
protocol_id: 0x80
This command is mandatory.

+---------------+--------------------------------------------------------------+
|Return values                                                                 |
+---------------+--------------------------------------------------------------+
|Name           |Description                                                   |
+---------------+--------------------------------------------------------------+
|int32 status   | See ARM SCMI Specification for status code definitions.      |
+---------------+--------------------------------------------------------------+
|uint32 version | For this revision of the specification, this value must be   |
|               | 0x10000.                                                     |
+---------------+--------------------------------------------------------------+

PROTOCOL_ATTRIBUTES
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

message_id: 0x1
protocol_id: 0x80
This command is mandatory.

+------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------+
|Return values                                                                 |
+------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------+
|Name              |Description                                                |
+------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------+
|int32 status      | See ARM SCMI Specification for status code definitions.   |
+------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------+
|int32 num_domains | Number of TinySYS domains. The TinySYS protocol assumes   |
|                  | that each domain provides one event source.               |
+------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------+

PROTOCOL_MESSAGE_ATTRIBUTES
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

message_id: 0x2
protocol_id: 0x80
This command is mandatory.

+------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------+
|Return values                                                                 |
+------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------+
|Name              |Description                                                |
+------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------+
|int32 status      |SUCCESS: in case the message is implemented and available  |
|                  |to use.                                                    |
|                  |NOT_FOUND: if the message identified by message_id is      |
|                  |invalid or not implemented                                 |
+------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------+
|uint32 attributes |Flags that are associated with a specific command in the   |
|                  |protocol. For all commands in this protocol, this          |
|                  |parameter has a value of 0                                 |
+------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------+

COMMON_GET
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

message_id: 0x3
protocol_id: 0x80
This command is mandatory.

+------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------+
|Parameters                                                                    |
+------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------+
|Name              |Description                                                |
+------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------+
|uint32 ctrl_id    | Control Identifier (index)                                |
+------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------+
|uint32 cmd        | Index (identifier) of the control                         |
+------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------+
|Return values                                                                 |
+------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------+
|Name              |Description                                                |
+------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------+
|int32 status      | SUCCESS: if the control was get successfully.             |
|                  | ERR_ENTRY: if the index is not valid (not found).         |
|                  | ERR_GENERIC: generic error                                |
+------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------+
|uint32 rsvd       | Reserved for future use                                   |
+------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------+
|uint32 reply[2]   | Value data array, the contents differ for each of the     |
|                  | different controls that are supported by the protocol.    |
+------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------+

COMMON_SET
~~~~~~~~

message_id: 0x4
protocol_id: 0x80
This command is mandatory.

+------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------+
|Parameters                                                                    |
+------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------+
|Name              |Description                                                |
+------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------+
|uint32 ctrl_id    | Control Identifier (index)                                |
+------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------+
|uint32            | Parameters data array, the contents differ for each of    |
|param[1..5]       | the different controls that are supported by the protocol |
+------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------+
|uint8 num_params  | Size of the parameters data in words                      |
+------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------+
|Return values                                                                 |
+------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------+
|Name              |Description                                                |
+------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------+
|int32 status      | SUCCESS: if the parameters were set successfully.         |
|                  | ERR_ENTRY: if the index is not valid (not found).         |
|                  | ERR_GENERIC: generic error                                |
+------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------+

POWER_STATE_NOTIFY
~~~~~~~~~

message_id: 0x5
protocol_id: 0x80
This command is mandatory.

look at slbc_ipi, mtk_qos_scmi, ssc_module

+------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------+
|Parameters                                                                    |
+------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------+
|Name              |Description                                                |
+------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------+
|uint32 fid        | Feature Identifier                                        |
+------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------+
|uint32            | Parameters data array, used to notify power states to the |
|param[0..3]       | different MCUs integrated into the SoC. This can be used  |
|                  | to control power of a HW subsystem or internal MCU.       |
|                  | The contents of this array differ for each feature that   |
|                  | is supported by the power state notifier in the protocol. | 
+------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------+
|Return values                                                                 |
+------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------+
|Name              |Description                                                |
+------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------+
|int32 status      | SUCCESS: if the parameters were set successfully.         |
|                  | ERR_ENTRY: if the index is not valid (not found).         |
|                  | ERR_GENERIC: generic error                                |
+------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------+

SLBC_CTRL
~~~~~~~~~~~~

message_id: 0x6
protocol_id: 0x80
This command is mandatory.

+------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------+
|Parameters                                                                    |
+------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------+
|Name              |Description                                                |
+------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------+
|uint32 rsvd       | Reserved for future use                                   |
+------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------+
|uint32 fid        | Feature (command) Identifier                              |
+------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------+
|uint32            | Parameters data array, the contents differ for each of    |
|param[0..3]       | the different features that are supported by the System   |
|                  | Level Buffer and Cache (SLBC) controls in TinySYS.        |
+------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------+
|Return values                                                                 |
+------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------+
|Name              |Description                                                |
+------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------+
|int32 status      | SUCCESS: if the parameters were set successfully.         |
|                  | ERR_ENTRY: if the index is not valid (not found).         |
|                  | ERR_GENERIC: generic error                                |
+------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------+
